Maya (Marketing Ops): Heads-up — inbound lead SLA alert this morning. ~7% of leads in EMEA not routed to owners within 15m. Seeing enrichment holdups from HubSpot->SF webhook. Anyone else?
Jules (RevOps): Yep, noticed. Enrichment jobs backlogged between 01:10-01:40 UTC, ~12k msgs. Looks like our enrichment worker hit rate limit with vendor API.
Priya (Growth): Impacted landing pages are paid search + webinar signups. Leads are created in HS but enrichment webhook delayed, so owner assignment rule (which depends on enrichment tag) never fires.
Omar (Sales Ops): Could we fallback to 'default regional pool' if enrichment doesn't arrive in X mins? That avoids unowned leads.
Maya (Marketing Ops): Agreed. Proposed temporary flow: HS workflow checks enrichment status after 10m; if still pending, assign to regional_oncall_bucket and add tag 'manually_enriched'.
Jules (RevOps): For clarity here's the pseudo-workflow:
```yaml
trigger: lead_created
wait: 600 # seconds
if: enrichment_status == 'pending'
then:
  - assign_owner: regional_oncall_bucket
  - add_tag: manually_enriched
  - notify: #ops
```
Priya (Growth): +1. Also can we add a soft-fallback in SF connector so mapping doesn't break? We saw mapping fails when owner null.
Omar (Sales Ops): I'll patch SF mapping to accept 'regional_oncall_bucket' as temp owner id.
Jules (RevOps): Also recommend adjusting enrichment retry window and adding circuit-breaker metrics. We should surface metric `hs.enrichment.latency_p95` to the console.
Maya (Marketing Ops): Ops checklist: 1) implement HS workflow fallback (Jules), 2) SF mapping patch (Omar), 3) add datadog alert for p95 (Priya), 4) run 24h smoke test and report (Maya).
Priya (Growth): I'll look at funnel/regression risk — need to check any downstream automation that expects enriched fields.
Omar (Sales Ops): ETA for SF patch 2h.
Jules (RevOps): I'll push HS workflow now, will post the exact rule id.
HubSpot Bot: Workflow 87421 deployed to test account.
Maya (Marketing Ops): Great — once live let's monitor unassigned-leads query: `created_at>now()-24h and owner=null`. If <1% after 24h we revert to normal.
Priya (Growth): Also suggest a quick customer-facing FAQ line for SDRs: "If lead appears unassigned, check 'manually_enriched' tag before outreach."
Maya (Marketing Ops): Note taken. Will update playbook. Thanks team :pray:
